headline: UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 NEEDS 🍆 New LAWS 📜 For AI 🤖 In HEALTHCARE 🩺 Says WATCHDOG 🐕
text:
BRITAIN'S 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 industry 🏭 watchdog 🐕 is straight up BEGGING 📣 for fresh 🍆 regulations 📜 on AI 🤖 tools 🛠️ getting RAILED 💦 into the NHS 🏥 and every other healthcare 🩺 setting as usage 📈 explodes 🌋!! The Medicines 🧪 and Healthcare 🩺 Products Regulatory Agency 🚦 known as MHRA 🛡️ has DROPPED 📤 a massive 44 recommendations 📋 to update its policies after watching AI 🤖 slowly EDGE 🫦 its way into medical 🩹 devices and treatments 💊!! Lawrence Tallon the MHRA chief 🧔‍♂️ told the BBC 📺 that soon patients 🧑‍⚕️ will be getting routinely POUNDED 🥊 by AI 🤖 as part of normal NHS 🏥 healthcare delivery 🚚 and that it better happen while keeping their trust 🫂 and confidence 😌 intact or the whole thing gets cooked 🍳!!

This whole report 📑 was cooked up 🧑‍🍳 by an independent commission 🧑‍⚖️ with input from over 12,000 people 👥 including patients 🛌 and clinicians 👨‍⚕️ who all weighed in on how to not let AI 🤖 turn into a total disaster 🚨!! Recommendations include continuously MONITORING 👀 AI products 🧰 and YANKING 🫳 them from approval if they start malfunctioning 🤖💥 or drifting away from being effective over time ⏳!! Patients 🧍 must get the RIGHT 🛡️ to KNOW 🧠 whether AI 🤖 is involved in their care 🩺 plus easy access 📲 to full info 📋 about the products so nobody feels like they're getting secretly RAILED 💦 by a robot without consent 🙅!! The framework also wants power ⚡ to PENALISE 🏛️ developers 👨‍💻 if their AI 🤖 fails standards and even an "L plate" 🅿️ system so new models can get TRIALED 🧪 under close supervision 👀 like horny interns learning the ropes 🪢!!

Lawrence Tallon 🧔‍♂️ explained the current medical device rules 📜 mostly date from the era of hip replacements 🦵 knee jobs 🦵 and basic stuff like stethoscopes 🩺 or plasters 🩹 which is why they are getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 by modern AI 🤖!! He said while simple AI trained to spot known symptoms on scans 📸 might still fit inside existing guidelines the more complex models are built different 🧱 and keep CHANGING 🔄 after authorization like they are learning 🧠 adapting and straight up DRIFTING 🛤️ into unknown territory!! Trying to regulate AI 🤖 is a GLOBAL 🌍 challenge he admitted and right now nobody can point to a single country 🗺️ or framework that has fully CRACKED 🥜 it yet so the UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 is edging 📏 toward new laws before things get out of hand 🫱!!

AI note-takers 📝 known as scribes ✍️ and powered by LLMs are already being used by 40 percent of UK-based GPs 👨‍⚕️ to record consultations 🗣️ and generate reports 📊 but a University of Edinburgh study found patients 🧍 might clams up 🦪 about personal stuff like substance abuse history if they knew an AI 🤖 was processing the convo 🫦!! Professor Henrietta Hughes 👩‍⚕️ who sat on the commission said many of her patients are totally down bad 😩 for AI during consultations but some just opt out saying they don't want to talk to a robot 🤖 and that's also fine!! She admitted the scribes can mess up notes 📝 but it's on the doctors 👨‍⚕️ to catch and correct those mistakes before anyone gets hurt 🩹!!

Right now AI 🤖 is mostly assisting with admin tasks 📋 or symptom spotting 🔎 under human expert oversight but there's MASSIVE excitement 😲 about its potential in health 🩺 and medical research 🧬 industries!! Professor Alastair Denniston 👁️ an ophthalmologist on the report called it an exceptional opportunity 🌟 that could rank alongside step-changes like antibiotics 💊 and MRI 🧲 scans!! In September Rene Haas the boss of chip designer Arm 💪 told the BBC he believes the tech will cook up 🧪 a cure for cancer 🎗️ within our lifetime which is wild 🐺!! Yet concerns remain about biases in training data 📉 leading to wrong decisions or chatbots spitting incorrect medical advice 🩺 that could seriously derail patient trust 🫂!!
